Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Subject : Audio recording of the Earnings Conference Call held with analysts/investors in relation 
to the Audited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and

release/ .

Thanking You,
